import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_emp_hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"].copy()
    asof_queries = inputs["asof_queries"].copy()
    
    # Perform the point-in-time join
    # For each query, find the history row where:
    # - emp_id matches
    # - as_of_date >= eff_start_date (start INCLUSIVE)
    # - eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date (end EXCLUSIVE)
    
    result = asof_queries.merge(
        dim_emp_hist,
        on="emp_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Apply the half-open interval logic
    # Start date is inclusive
    start_condition = result["as_of_date"] >= result["eff_start_date"]
    
    # End date: NULL means open-ended (current), otherwise exclusive upper bound
    end_condition = (result["eff_end_date"].isna()) | (result["as_of_date"] < result["eff_end_date"])
    
    # Filter to only rows satisfying both conditions
    result = result[start_condition & end_condition]
    
    # Select only the required output columns
    asof_result = result[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"asof_result": asof_result}
